title: Python: a listed non-factory class decorator is allowed only bare (@total_ordering(cls=X) refuses)
description: DEC-303 (a33) item 2, carried with the (a30) follow-up. A listed decorator that is NOT a decorator factory (functools.total_ordering, typing.final, typing.runtime_checkable, enum.unique) is allowed only BARE; a called form is allowed only for a listed FACTORY (dataclasses.dataclass), with keyword options only, under (a32) item 2's slots rule. #157 (GCLI-105) refuses a positional or ** splat argument to any listed decorator but still allows a KEYWORD argument, so @total_ordering(cls=X) still resolves and replaces the class. Fix: refuse any called form of a non-factory listed decorator; fixtures: @total_ordering(cls=X), @final(cls=X), @enum.unique(cls=E) refused at E1, N3 and 6d, with bare twins allowed and dataclass(frozen=True) still allowed; mutation-check the guard. Must land before the fresh blind sample (DEC-303 (a31) item 4). Carried with the staticmethod case of (a31) item 5 (GCLI-102, closed). Depends on #157 landing.

implementationNotes: Built (DEC-303 (a33) item 2). ClassInfo.decoratorCalled records whether each class decorator is written @d(...); hasReplacingDecorator now refuses any called form unless the decorator is in NON_REPLACING_CLASS_DECORATOR_FACTORIES = {dataclasses.dataclass}; a called dataclass stays under (a32) item 2's slots rule. So total_ordering, final, runtime_checkable and unique are allowed only bare: @total_ordering(cls=X), @total_ordering(X), @total_ordering(), @functools.total_ordering(cls=X), an aliased total_ordering(cls=X), @final(cls=X), @typing.runtime_checkable(cls=X), @unique(cls=X) all refuse at E1, N3 and 6d; the bare forms and dataclass(frozen=True), also through an alias, still resolve. Mutation checks (source restored each time, 6 mutants, each 1 red): called guard removed, factory test removed, called-always, empty factory set, called flag always false, and the (a32) slots guard. PER-SITE MEASURE, instrumented worktrees at origin/dev 2ab82ef vs the branch, five pins, multiset diff: 0 changed on flask, jinja, httpx, rich, tqdm (entry counts equal): the corpus has no called non-factory listed decorator, so the recall cost of this rule on the pins is nil. NOT MEASURED: precision (no site changed); decorators on a base class are still not read. Full gates: typecheck, lint, format:check, bun test 815 pass, lore check --strict 0.14.1.
